title: 探针参数聚合分析
remark: 支持按 IP 地址或启动 ID 分析探针消息，并从命中总量、时间趋势、时间轴以及事实类型、探针 SDK、识别标签和处置类型分布等视角展示聚合结果。

body.body: 从 IP 或启动 ID 链接进入时会自动查询；也可以修改参数类型、参数值和统计周期后重新聚合。

api.requestAdaptor: var type=api.data.query_type==='start_id'?'start_id':'ip';var value=api.data.focus_value===undefined||api.data.focus_value===null?'':String(api.data.focus_value).trim();var preset=api.data.time_preset||'LAST_7_DAYS';api.data={focus_value:value,mappings:[{entity:'probe_agent_message',label:type==='start_id'?'启动 ID 命中':'IP 地址命中',match_fields:type==='start_id'?['start_id']:['lan_ip','wan_ip'],time_field:'zenvis_insert_time',criteria_list:[],criteria_logic:'or'}],time_range:{preset:preset}};return api;

api.requestAdaptor: var type=api.data.query_type==='start_id'?'start_id':'ip';var value=api.data.focus_value===undefined||api.data.focus_value===null?'':String(api.data.focus_value).trim();var preset=api.data.time_preset||'LAST_7_DAYS';var criteria=type==='start_id'?[{attribute:'start_id',operator:'equal',value_list:[value]}]:[{attribute:'lan_ip',operator:'equal',value_list:[value]},{attribute:'wan_ip',operator:'equal',value_list:[value]}];api.data={series:[{entity:'probe_agent_message',label:type==='start_id'?'启动 ID 命中':'IP 地址命中',metric:{name:'hit_count',operation:'COUNT',label:'命中消息数'},time_field:'zenvis_insert_time',criteria_list:criteria,criteria_logic:'or'}],time_range:{preset:preset},granularity:preset==='LAST_30_DAYS'?'DAY':'HOUR',comparison:'NONE',criteria_list:[],criteria_logic:'and'};return api;

api.adaptor: var d=payload&&payload.data?payload.data:{};var records=Array.isArray(d.datalist)?d.datalist:[];var total=Number(d.total||0);var trend=api&&Array.isArray(api.trendRows)?api.trendRows:[];var preset=api&&api.timelinePreset?api.timelinePreset:'LAST_7_DAYS';var groups=Object.create(null);var agendaCounts=Object.create(null);var punishCounts=Object.create(null);function add(list,value){var text=value===undefined||value===null?'':String(value).trim();if(text&&list.indexOf(text)<0){list.push(text);}}function values(value){if(Array.isArray(value)){return value;}if(value===undefined||value===null||value===''){return [];}if(typeof value==='string'){try{var parsed=JSON.parse(value);if(Array.isArray(parsed)){return parsed;}}catch(e){}return value.split(',');}return [value];}function countDistinct(target,value){var seen=Object.create(null);values(value).forEach(function(item){var text=item===undefined||item===null?'':String(item).trim();if(text&&!seen[text]){seen[text]=true;target[text]=(target[text]||0)+1;}});}function topRows(target){return Object.keys(target).map(function(name){return {name:name,value:target[name]};}).sort(function(a,b){return b.value-a.value||String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name));}).slice(0,10);}function group(bucket){if(!groups[bucket]){groups[bucket]={count:0,categories:[],tags:[],punishes:[]};}return groups[bucket];}trend.forEach(function(row){var count=Number(row.value||0);if(count>0){group(String(row.bucket||'')).count=count;}});records.forEach(function(record){var raw=String(record.zenvis_insert_time||'').replace('T',' ');var bucket=preset==='LAST_30_DAYS'?raw.slice(0,10):raw.slice(0,13)+':00:00';if(bucket){var item=group(bucket);if(!item.count){item.count+=1;}add(item.categories,record.fact_type);values(record.agenda_tags).forEach(function(value){add(item.tags,value);});values(record.punish_types).forEach(function(value){add(item.punishes,value);});}countDistinct(agendaCounts,record.agenda_tags);countDistinct(punishCounts,record.punish_types);});var timeline=Object.keys(groups).filter(function(bucket){return bucket&&groups[bucket].count>0;}).sort().map(function(bucket){var item=groups[bucket];var category=item.categories.length?item.categories.join('、'):'无';var tags=item.tags.length?item.tags.join('、'):'无';var punishes=item.punishes.length?item.punishes.join('、'):'无';return {time:bucket,title:'命中 '+item.count+' 条消息',detail:'数据类别：'+category+'；识别标签：'+tags+'；处置类型：'+punishes,color:item.count>=10?'#059669':'#2563eb'};});var agendaRows=topRows(agendaCounts);var punishRows=topRows(punishCounts);return {status:0,msg:'',data:{timeline_items:timeline,timeline_count:timeline.length,timeline_truncated:total>records.length,timeline_loaded:records.length,timeline_total:total,sample_loaded:records.length,sample_total:total,sample_truncated:total>records.length,agenda_distribution_count:agendaRows.length,punish_distribution_count:punishRows.length,agenda_dataset:{dimensions:['name','value'],source:agendaRows},punish_dataset:{dimensions:['name','value'],source:punishRows}}};
